topic: Promo two: before and after, six hours of manual editing against one topic line in and one finished animated video out
title: BEFORE AND AFTER
ONE TOPIC LINE

script.text: Hours of manual editing for one short video. Tomorrow you do it again.
Now picture this instead. You type one topic line, and that is all.
The pipeline writes the script from your line. Then it records the voice.
It cuts a shot list on every spoken word. Then it builds every scene.
Every frame is animated in code. Nothing is filmed.
Sound is built to match the picture. Audio is mastered to minus fourteen LUFS.
And out comes a finished video. Like this one.
You get the engine, the cast, the sets, the scripts, and the guides.
You bring your own keys for voice and writing. No keys come inside.
One topic line in. One finished video out. That is the whole idea.

science.claim: Six hours of manual editing for one short video.
science.working: An illustrative before scenario set by the brief, not a measured statistic. No saving is claimed.

science.claim: One topic line in, one finished video out.
science.working: The topic line goes in, then voice, plan, sound, render and master scripts run through run_episode.sh and produce one mastered video.
science.source: brief_promo2.md, What the VM does with your files

science.claim: The pipeline writes the script from your line.
science.working: The narration, shots, cuts and sound plan are written from the topic line.
voice makes one ElevenLabs call per script line and builds words.json.

science.claim: It cuts a shot list on every spoken word.
science.working: Edit cues reference spoken words; plan turns them into frames, a word cut landing 2 frames before the word.

science.claim: It draws a storyboard you can check before anything renders.
science.working: Storyboard stills are checked before animation; a still renders in about two seconds.

science.claim: Every frame is animated in code.
science.working: Every shot is a pure function of its own clock t, rendered with Remotion.

science.claim: Sound is built to match the picture.
science.working: sound generates each clip once and places events by cue on shots and words.

science.claim: Audio is mastered to minus fourteen LUFS.
science.working: master.py brings the final mix to -14 LUFS with true peaks under -1 dBTP.

science.claim: You get the engine, the cast, the sets, the scripts and the guides. (On screen: 7 sets.)
science.working: Engine exports, cast looks, sets bedroom, classroom, kitchen, rooftop, schematic, stairwell, study = 7, the VM scripts, and the reference guides.
science.source: kit.md; engine index listing in the brief

science.claim: You bring your own keys for voice and writing. No keys come inside.
science.working: The voice step and the writing step need the buyer's own accounts; a key is never put in a file.
